name: STRUCT_VERTEXCUT_V1
ruling_2026-09-15_ninth: Change the partition representation itself from 'hard nodes + halo afterward' to 'overlap is part of the partition definition' ... vertex-cut / overlapping partitioning: edges are assigned to partitions and a vertex is replicated into every partition containing one of its edges (PowerGraph; DistDGL halo nodes) ... partition STRUCT edges, not nodes ... z: E -> {1..k}; B_p = {v : exists e containing v, z(e) = p}. Now nodes naturally overlap ... There is no special halo operation afterward. The overlap is the partition ... dual incidence hypergraph -- one hypergraph vertex for each STRUCT edge x_e; for every original graph node v, a hyperedge h_v = {x_e : e incident to v}. Then partition the x_e's. lambda(h_v) is exactly the number of partitions in which v has to appear; sum_v (lambda(h_v) - 1) is basically minimizing node replication ... We construct a query-independent overlapping representation that preserves local graph topology and short connected paths under a bounded replication budget. No queries. No gold answers. No workload statistics. No labels required ... one engineering issue: block capacity ... We need ~100 unique nodes per served block ... Standard PHG won't enforce that exact nonlinear quantity automatically. For the first diagnostic I would: partition edge-vertices with PHG; materialize endpoint sets; measure actual unique nodes/block; perform deterministic capacity repair if necessary; count replication factor. Do not silently compare a 170-node overlapping block against a 100-node hard block. Keep either: same unique-node exposure at P50, or a strict block capacity ... The metrics I would use before even running retrieval: Replication factor RF = sum_p |B_p| / |V|; 1-hop edge containment; 2-hop wedge containment: for every u-m-v, whether exists p: {u,m,v} subset B_p -- this is the really interesting one; 3-hop path containment similarly as a diagnostic. Then compare those against current PHG hard+halo. If the new scheme doesn't materially improve two-hop containment for a reasonable replication factor, we don't even need the expensive retrieval replay ... one new partition arm, not another factorial: STRUCT_VERTEXCUT_V1 ... No relation labels. No queries. No gold. No training. No embedding changes ... I would not immediately contaminate this first diagnostic with KNN.
what_this_is: A query-free, gold-free, label-free structural diagnostic of ONE new partition representation for the STRUCT graph. It produces containment / replication numbers only. It does NOT touch any replay cache, any query, any embedding, any served partition, anything under data/, and it does NOT run a retrieval replay (that needs a ruling). H2_PATCH1 (section 16) and the H3_PATCH1 workstream are independent.

construction_frozen.graph: undirected, de-duplicated STRUCT edges of the canonical dataset exactly as CanonicalDataset(ds).keysets() returns them (keys u*N+v, u < v, self loops dropped); no KNN, no NERX, no relation labels, no direction
construction_frozen.hypergraph_vertices: one per STRUCT edge, in ascending key order (object id = position in the sorted key array); unit vertex weight
construction_frozen.hyperedges_nets: one per original node with STRUCT degree >= 2: h_v = {x_e : e incident to v}; unit net weight. Nodes of degree 0 or 1 form no net (a 0- or 1-pin net can never be cut and contributes 0 to every objective; the net -> node map is stored). Pins = 2|E| minus the pins of degree-1 nodes.
construction_frozen.objective: Zoltan-PHG CONNECTIVITY (km1) with unit net weights = sum over nets (lambda(h_v) - 1) = total node replication of the endpoint sets = (RF - 1) * N restricted to degree >= 2 nodes; this is the ruling's objective verbatim
construction_frozen.partitioner: the validated PHG substitute exactly as scratchpad/_l1c_phg.py runs it for every scratch hypergraph of this lane (src/l1_lowmem/phg.py mpirun; NP = 4; IMBALANCE_TOL 1.03 on hypergraph-vertex (edge) counts; driver binary/wrapper sha checked against PHG_BUILD.json; validity bound ceil(1.03 |E| / k) edges per part; empty parts repaired by the generic PHG_NONEMPTY_REPAIR_V1 rule). Balance is on EDGES per part, as the ruling anticipates; the unique-node block size is measured.
construction_frozen.blocks: B_p = endpoint set of the edges assigned to part p (materialised after partitioning). A node of degree 0 belongs to no block (counted and reported; metaqa has none, squad 6,349, musique 9,858 -- a served version would need a home rule for them; not decided here).

k_grid.curve: k in {k_f, 2 k_f, 3 k_f} with k_f = the frozen k of the dataset (metaqa 432, squad 202, musique 1,175) -- the replication / containment curve; blocks at k_f hold ~ |E|/k_f edges and are expected to be LARGER than the hard block (unmatched, reported for the curve only)
k_grid.matched_k_star: target = mean unique nodes per block equal to the hard block capacity C = round(N / k_f) (100 on all three). Fixed point from the 2 k_f run: k_1 = round(RF(2 k_f) * N / C); then k_{i+1} = round(RF(k_i) * N / C) until |mean |B_p| - C| <= 0.05 C or three k* runs; every run is recorded. RF = sum_p |B_p| / N over ALL N nodes.
k_grid.strict_capacity_cell: the deterministic capacity repair below with C = round(N / k_f) applied to the k* partition (the last k* run)

construction_frozen.capacity_repair_rule_deterministic: while some block has |B_p| > C: take the block with the largest |B_p| (ties: smallest id); its candidate nodes in the order (fewest edges assigned to p, then larger STRUCT degree, then smaller node id); for the first candidate v whose p-edges can ALL be moved, move each p-edge e = (v, w) (ascending edge id) to the target t != p of the lowest class -- class 0: t already contains both v and w (no size change, no new replica); class 1: t contains w, |B_t| < C (v joins t); class 2: t contains v, |B_t| < C (w joins t); class 3: t contains neither, |B_t| <= C - 2 -- ties within a class: smallest |B_t|, then smallest t; memberships and sizes are updated after each edge move (so v's later edges prefer the block v just joined). A node that cannot be fully evicted is skipped; a block with no evictable node is left over-full and reported as residual overflow. Each successful eviction lowers the total overflow by >= 1 and never pushes a target above C, so the loop terminates. Moves, evictions, the replication change and the residual are recorded.

baselines_same_metrics.hard_MtK: the served metaqa Mt-KaHyPar H4_SK partition (replay_cache.npz 'hard'; k_f blocks; |B_p| <= 103) -- the canonical L1 substrate
baselines_same_metrics.hard_PHG: the served metaqa PHG+repair partition (replay_cache__LOWMEM__PHG_REPAIR1_con.npz 'hard'); squad: replay_cache.npz and the LOWMEM__PHG_con cache; musique: the LOWMEM__PHG_C1_con cache (its only served partition)
baselines_same_metrics.hard_plus_legacy_membership: the served VOTING unit: node r is a member of its own block and of the blocks of its directed STRUCT out-neighbours (_l1s_core.Data.legacy_mem); block-centric: B_p^mem = B_p + {r : some out-neighbour of r is in B_p}; sizes reported -- UNMATCHED (larger than the served block); this is the 'current PHG hard+halo' of the ruling
baselines_same_metrics.hard_plus_undirected_halo: B_p + N(B_p) (all undirected STRUCT neighbours; the DistDGL-style halo); sizes reported -- UNMATCHED
baselines_same_metrics.H4_SK_PATH2_PHG: the section 3/4 higher-order hard construction (parts/<ds>__H4_SK_PATH2__PHG_con.npy) where it exists (metaqa, squad)

metrics_all_query_free.RF: sum_p |B_p| / N (all N nodes; degree-0 nodes contribute 0)
metrics_all_query_free.block_sizes: |B_p| min / mean / p50 / p90 / max, blocks > C, blocks > 1.5 C
metrics_all_query_free.replication: sum_v max(lambda_v - 1, 0) = total replicas beyond one; hub (deg + 1 > C) vs non-hub lambda mean and max
metrics_all_query_free.edge_containment_1hop: fraction of STRUCT edges (u, v) with some block containing both (vertex-cut: 1 by construction; hard: 1 - cut fraction)
metrics_all_query_free.wedge_containment_2hop_PRIMARY: over all wedges u-m-v (unordered pairs of distinct neighbours of m, every m with degree >= 2): fraction with some block p containing u, m and v -- computed EXACTLY per middle node by the pair-union rule (pair contained iff the two neighbours share a block that also contains m); reported (a) over all wedges, (b) over wedges with a NON-HUB middle (deg(m) + 1 <= C; the primary number, because hub-centred wedges are >= 90 % of all wedges on every graph and cannot be kept together by any bounded block), (c) the per-node mean of the contained fraction over non-hub middles
metrics_all_query_free.path_containment_3hop: over simple 3-paths u-m1-m2-v (u != v, u != m2, v != m1) with middle edge (m1, m2): fraction with some block containing all four; exact per middle edge by the same pair-union rule; (a) all middle edges, (b) both middles non-hub; exact on every middle edge when |E| <= 300,000 (metaqa), otherwise a deterministic stride sample of 200,000 middle edges in ascending key order (squad, musique; labelled as a sample)
metrics_all_query_free.ball2_intact_section2: the section 2 metric: fraction of non-hub nodes whose closed 2-hop non-hub STRUCT ball (<= C nodes) lies inside ONE block (vertex-cut: some block contains the whole ball), plus the mean best-single-block coverage of the ball
metrics_all_query_free.matched_exposure_note: cells are compared at equal mean unique nodes per block; a P50 selection of overlapping blocks exposes FEWER unique nodes than 50 disjoint blocks of the same size, so the matched cell is conservative for the vertex-cut

decision_rule_structural_only.MATERIAL: at the strict-capacity cell (k*, capacity-repaired; residual over-full blocks <= 1 % of blocks): non-hub-middle 2-hop wedge containment >= 2 x the served hard partition's value AND an absolute gain >= +20 pts AND RF <= 3.0; secondary: section-2 ball intact fraction >= 2 x the served value (metaqa: 8.4 % -> >= 16.8 %)
decision_rule_structural_only.what_follows: MATERIAL means the ruling's precondition for a retrieval replay is met; the replay itself is NOT run without a further ruling (it needs the served-unit contract: how P50 selects overlapping blocks, exposure matching, homes for degree-0 nodes). NOT_MATERIAL closes STRUCT_VERTEXCUT_V1 at the structural level. Either way the full k-curve is reported.
decision_rule_structural_only.primary_dataset: metaqa (the structural-locality problem of sections 2-3 and 14-16); squad and musique are secondary curves

forbidden: reading any query, seed, gold label or replay cache beyond the served 'hard' vectors used as baselines
KNN or NERX edges, relation labels, edge direction in the construction
any objective, imbalance, NP or driver parameter other than the validated PHG contract
any k outside the grid + fixed-point rule; any second capacity rule; any tuning on the containment numbers
a retrieval replay, an L1 evaluation, or a modification of any served partition / cache / record; anything under data/
